source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 368 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 368.

PD 368.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 368 was established by Ordinance No. 21321, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 10, 1992. Ordinance No. 21321 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 21321 was amended by Ordinance No. 22598, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 8, 1995. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21321; 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 368 is established on property generally located along the south line of Churchill Way, east of the east line of Preston Road. The size of PD 368 is approximately 12.084 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) The Property is divided into three tracts as indicated on the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 368A).

(d) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 368A: development/landscape plan.

(2) Exhibit 368B: traffic management plan. (Ord. 29696)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.105. DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan.

(b) If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Private school for kindergarten through 12th grade.

(b) Child-care facility. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A- 4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 100 feet, except that one clock tower, as shown on the development/landscape plan, may be constructed with a minimum setback of 50 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.35 for all uses combined.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 40 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 30 percent.

(g) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the development/landscape plan.

(b) Parking is permitted in the front yard, as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) The Property is considered one lot for off-street parking and loading regulations.

(d) Off-street loading must be provided in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) A minimum of 10 trees of six-inch or greater caliper and shrubbery, ground cover, or buffer plant materials listed in Section 51A-10.125(b)(7) must be provided within the 30-foot landscape buffer located at the southeast corner of the property as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) A minimum of six large canopy trees of six-inch or greater caliper, and a minimum of seven large canopy trees of three-inch or greater caliper must be provided within the 15-foot landscaped buffer on the eastern boundary of the Property as shown on the development and\/landscape plan. The large canopy trees must be spaced at least 25 feet apart.

(d) The eight-foot-high masonry screening wall at the southeast corner of the Property, as shown on the development/landscape plan, must be maintained.

(e) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) Backlit signs are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Traffic Management Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.113. TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PLAN.

(a) The operation of the uses must comply with the traffic management plan (Exhibit 368B).

(b) The following regulations apply to all traffic operations and circulation:

(1) Queuing is permitted inside the Property only.

(2) Drop-off or pick-up is not permitted in the city’s right-of-way.

(c) A survey of traffic operations and circulation that evaluates compliance with the traffic management plan must be submitted to the director of public works and transportation by April 8, 2020, every five years thereafter, and with each new or amended development plan. The survey must be in writing and contain the following:

(1) a review of ingress and egress points,

(2) queue lengths needed and provided,

(3) the number and location of the school administrators assisting with loading and unloading of students,

(4) drop-off and pick-up locations,

(5) school hours for each grade level,

(6) hours of operation for the child-care facility, and

(7) drop-off and pick-up hours for each grade level.

(d) No amendment to the traffic management plan may be approved by the city plan commission unless the owner has provided, with its application for such amendment, evidence that written notice has been sent by certified mail return receipt requested, to the owners of Lots 6 and 7 of City Block 5/7460.

(e) The city plan commission shall authorize minor amendments to the traffic management plan if the proposed plan is approved by the director of transportation and public works following the standards and procedures in Subsection 51A-4.803(e) through (k) and does not adversely impact neighboring properties. (Ord. Nos. 21321; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.114. LIGHTING.

(a) No lighting is permitted on the play fields. Lighting on the clock tower, as shown on the development/landscape plan, is restricted to one 100-watt light on each side, attached to the clock tower seven feet above grade, and pointed upward to illuminate the clock.

(b) Lighting is not permitted along any portion of the modified private drive/fire lane on Tract II south of the access gate as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) Exterior wall lighting on any building within Tracts II and III must be directed toward that portion of the wall located between grade and the height of the covered walkway.

(d) Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, light poles may not exceed 25 feet in height. In the Tract II parking area, light poles may not exceed eight feet in height within 40 feet of the eastern Property boundary and 12 feet in height between 40 feet and 100 feet of the eastern Property boundary.

(e) All lighting must comply with the glare regulations in Section 51A-6.104.

(f) Exterior lighting intensity at the east Property line between Churchill Way and 400 feet south of Churchill Way may not exceed 0.10 horizontal foot candles measured at the Property line. (Ord. Nos. 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Clock Chimes And Speakers
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.115. CLOCK CHIMES AND SPEAKERS.

(a) Chimes are prohibited from ringing between the hours of 6:01 p.m. and 7:59 a.m. daily. Any chimes produced by the clock must comply with Article VI.

(b) Other than an emergency notification system, a permanent exterior public address system is not permitted. (Ord. Nos. 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Enrollment
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.116. ENROLLMENT.

(a) The combined maximum enrollment for the private school and child-care facility is 700.

(b) The maximum enrollment for grades 10 through 12 is 135 to be phased as follows:

(1) For the school year 2014-2015, the maximum enrollment for grades 10 through 12 is 35.

(2) For the school years 2015-2016 and 2016-2017, the maximum enrollment for grades 10 through 12 is 90.

(3) For the school years 2017-2018 through 2019-2020, the maximum enrollment for grades 10 through 12 is 120.

(4) For the school years 2020-2021 and beyond, the maximum enrollment for grades 10 through 12 is 135. (Ord. Nos. 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Regulations For Portable Classroom
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.117. REGULATIONS FOR PORTABLE CLASSROOM BUILDINGS.

(a) Portable classroom buildings may be placed in the zone for portable classroom buildings in the location shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) Portable classroom buildings may only be used for classrooms, libraries, studios, faculty offices, and study halls in conjunction with a private school or child-care facility that are displaced from the permanent buildings due to construction or remodeling of the permanent buildings.

(c) A portable classroom building may be used until construction or remodeling of the main building is complete or 18 months after the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for first portable classroom building placed in the zone for portable classroom buildings, whichever is earlier. Once this time has expired, all portable classroom buildings must be removed from the Property. Additional portable classroom buildings may not be placed in the zone for portable classroom buildings until one year after removal of the previous portable classroom buildings. After one year, portable classroom buildings may be placed in the zone for portable classroom buildings according to the timeline described in this subsection. (Ord. 29696)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.118. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22598 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-368.119. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22598; 25850; 25972; 26709; 29696)
